hooks.command: bash -lc 'd="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -f "$d/.codex/hooks/invoke-skincos-supervisor.sh" ]; do d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; if [ -f "$d/.codex/hooks/invoke-skincos-supervisor.sh" ]; then exec "$d/.codex/hooks/invoke-skincos-supervisor.sh"; else printf "%s\n" "{\"continue\":true,\"stopReason\":\"SKINCOS supervisor: project hook runner not found\"}"; fi'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$d=(Get-Location).Path; while ($d -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d '.codex\hooks\invoke-skincos-supervisor.ps1'))) { $p=Split-Path -Parent $d; if ($p -eq $d) { $d=$null } else { $d=$p } }; if ($d) { & (Join-Path $d '.codex\hooks\invoke-skincos-supervisor.ps1') } else { [Console]::Out.WriteLine('{\"continue\":true,\"stopReason\":\"SKINCOS supervisor: project hook runner not found\"}') }"
